description: The one-verb primitive. Say where value should go; Robyn returns the best route (all rails compared), the gasless method (no native token needed), the privacy posture that will apply (API-relay + private mempool where available + uniform shape), and what the settlement receipt will prove — in a SINGLE call. It collapses quote + preflight + prepare. Planning only: it never broadcasts — sign + submit via robyn_submit. Add private:true to request private-mempool execution where an endpoint exists.

amount.description: value in source-token base units (e.g. "25000000" = 25 USDC)

fromAddress.description: sender — sets fee tier and free-netting eligibility

fromToken.description: symbol or address; omit for the chain default (USDC)

private.description: request private-mempool execution (default: auto where an endpoint exists)

toChain.description: destination chain id or non-EVM name

name: robyn_settle
title: Settle value privately, gasless, best-route — one call
